title: MarxKapital: A Computational Framework for Marxian Value Theory with Real Empirical Calibration
description: MarxKapital is an open-source Julia package for the mathematical modeling of Marxian value theory: capital accumulation, the tendency of the rate of profit, the transformation of labor values into prices of production, and the sectoral dynamics of expanded reproduction. Beyond the classical two-department and generalized N-department reproduction schemes, it implements three coupling mechanisms for sectoral accumulation through the technical matrix A -- capital mobility, an aggregate realization-pressure heuristic, and an exact per-sector quantity-rationing scheme solved by fixed-point iteration -- and a live, reproducible empirical calibration pipeline drawing directly from official European statistical sources (Eurostat and AMECO, via their SDMX REST APIs). An accompanying academic paper (paper/main.tex) applies the pipeline to Portugal.
